hub.notes: One-tap Join Another Hub's Game; skip a player's next turn; leave-node-mode confirm; 3h untouched sleep (wake-press can no longer trigger a factory wipe); faster reconnect - 3s in-game detection, no more going deaf while a node is missing, and reconnect time is now measured

node.notes: 3h untouched deep sleep (a turn cue counts as use, so a node can't sleep out of a long game); waking by button can no longer run into the factory-wipe countdown; cleaner disconnect when sleeping while still connected
